skill_api.execution: Only four supplied RPC methods. No imports/files/network/hidden simulation access. Use finite loops. Return gracefully if perception/planning is unavailable; do not retry uncertain manipulation. Returning ends code, then bounded measured-position hold until independent native evaluator termination.

geometry.quaternion_requirement: Normalize to unit length using arithmetic; imports unavailable

methods.approach: robot.approach(arm="left" or "right", position_m=[x,y,z], quaternion_wxyz=[w,x,y,z]); collision-aware released CuRobo joint trajectory, other arm/gripper preserved; raises RuntimeError if no path. No pose success claim.
methods.gripper: robot.gripper(arm="left" or "right", command=0 closed or 1 open) -> observed joints; settling only, no grasp success claim
methods.reobserve: robot.reobserve() -> {state: observed joint arrays}; no score
methods.scene: robot.scene() -> {objects: {"<category>_<positive_instance_index>": {pose:[x,y,z,w,x,y,z],dims:[x,y,z]}}, observation}; keys are strings. Examples: basket_1, watch_2, toy_car_1. Split at the last underscore; category is a string, only the final instance suffix is an integer. RGB estimates, world-frame metres; no hidden layouts or success signal.

scene_object_key_contract.identity: Equal category strings indicate the same class; full keys identify distinct visible instances, not persistent tracking identities.
scene_object_key_contract.parsing: Split at the LAST underscore. Keep category as a string; only the final suffix is an integer. Do not call int() on the whole key.
scene_object_key_contract.scope: Names are produced by this study's RGB adapter; examples contain no evaluation layout or success signal.

skill_api.scope: Study-specific bounded System2 iteration using step4-qualified calibrated RGB/CuRobo primitives; not stock paper performance or a full dynamic-object collision model
skill_api.semantics: Sort visible objects by category into separate baskets; assign one basket per category, grouping identical objects together. No success signal is available from primitives.
